newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-Serla up on above-forecast Q1 earnings.
newsitem.headline: M-Serla up on above-forecast Q1 earnings.

text.p: Shares in Finnish forestry group Metsa-Serla Oy inched higher in healthy trade on Monday following an above-forecast first quarter earnings report, brokers said.
At 1310/1010 GMT, Metsa-Serla traded at 40.00 markka, up 0.50 markka or a little above one percent. Volume was healthy at 7.7 million markka.
Brokers said the 129 million markka profit after financial items -- compared to a median forecast of a 20 million markka profit -- created active demand for the share.
"Metsa-Serla's Q1 earnings came as a positive surprise ... many will have to revise their full-year earnings forecasts higher," one broker said.
Some brokers said there was already an ample supply of Metsa-Serla shares on the market and therefore gains were capped at around 40.00 markka.
"But looking ahead, the share is more likley to rise than fall," another broker said.
